metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, did I just help this noob?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did the enemy just forget to play?
My aim was on vacation but the kill still landed.
Click if your kills come from pure chaos!
Tap if Valorant logic confuses you too.

Tap in if you’ve ever gotten a kill that made no sense!
